<!--
Base branch matters here. Sprint work does NOT go straight to main — see docs/BRANCHING.md.
CI enforces this: a `sprint/*` branch targeting `main` fails the "Base Branch Guard" check.
-->

## Base branch

- [ ] Sprint work → targets the active `dev/<series>` integration branch
- [ ] Series rollup (`dev/<series>` → `main`), hotfix, or repo plumbing → targets `main`
